mode.video.hint: Translates what you hear: a video, a class, a podcast
mode.notes.hint: Transcribes classes and meetings without translating, with speakers and a summary
mode.call.hint: Both ways: what you hear and what you say
mode.callSoon.hint: Coming soon: translate a call in both directions
error.missingListenModel: the model to listen to {lang} is missing. Download it in the diagnostics above.
error.cantListen: {lang} can't be listened to locally yet. Choose another language for what you hear.
error.missingTranslateModel: the translation model is missing. Download it in the diagnostics above.
error.inputLost: The audio input was lost: the device was disconnected or the system audio restarted. Press “Translate automatically” again; if it doesn't respond, restart Lingora.
lane.floatOpen: Floating captions, on top of any window
lane.subtitles.original.hint: What is said, in its own language, untranslated
lane.subtitles.both.hint: The original in small text above each translation
lane.voice.off.hint: Text only: you hear the original and no delay builds up
lane.voice.female.missing: This language has no female voice on your computer
lane.voice.male.missing: This language has no male voice on your computer
lane.noVoicesNote: Your computer has no voice for this language: captions only. On Mac you can download them for free in System Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → Manage Voices.
lane.saveNotes.on: The conversation is saved to Notes. Turn it off so a part isn't saved.
lane.saveNotes.off: Nothing said now is saved. Turn it on to keep saving.
lane.noSignal.mac: No sound is coming in. Check that the video or call is playing and that Lingora has permission in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen & System Audio Recording.
lane.noSignal.blackhole: No sound is coming through BlackHole. Check that the video or call is playing and review the diagnostics above.
lane.noSignal.mic: No sound is coming from the microphone. Check the input and its volume in System Settings → Sound.
lane.empty2: as captions, as soon as each sentence ends.
lane.lagSkipped: {secs} s delay · voice skipped to catch up
lane.details: Chunk {dur} s · transcription {stt} ms · translation {tr} ms
pair.untranslated: Untranslated: captions are in the original language (panel settings)
pair.swapDisabled: That language can't be listened to locally yet
voices.preview.hint: Hear a sentence with this voice
voices.speed.hint: Only speeds up when it falls behind. Higher catches up to the original sooner; lower sounds more natural.
devices.outputHint: Used when the voice is on (Female or Male).
